Title: Azure Monitor Agent and Data Collection Rules Public Preview

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor is introducing a new concept for data collection configuration and a new, unified agent for Azure Monitor in Public Preview. The new agent and Data Collection Rules improve on a few key areas of data collection from VMs in Azure Monitor including:

  •  
  • Send data to both Log Analytics and Azure Monitor metrics.
  • Scope data collection to subsets of VMs for a single workspace.
  • Send data to multiple workspaces on Linux VMs (multi-homing).
  • Improved Windows event filtering.
